item.title: Kaiser Permanente mental health workers in Santa Rosa set to strike this month
item.description: Kaiser mental health workers in Santa Rosa, Oakland, Santa Clara, Sacramento and Fresno are set to picket in a one-day strike, accusing the health care provider of using AI to replace staff.
